note: Synthetic files from dataset/gen.ts via scripts/make-samples.ts. No customer artwork.

samples.title: Market stall stickers
samples.story: Transparent artwork with no cut path. RollCue infers die-cut stickers and has already traced a contour and prepared the production PDF.

intake.notes: die cut stickers for the market stall

samples.title: stickers-final.pdf
samples.story: Named like a sticker job, but it is one A4 window poster. RollCue leans sticker on thin evidence; correcting it shows recovery.

samples.title: Honey jar labels
samples.story: A clean label file that already carries a stroked CutContour. Nothing to fix; RollCue keeps the supplied cut.

samples.title: Shop window poster (low resolution)
samples.story: A 700-pixel JPEG asked for at A2. RollCue prepares a polite return notice instead of a blurry print.

intake.notes: poster for the shop window, A2

samples.title: Shop banner supplied at 1:10
samples.story: Drawn at 300 × 100 mm, ordered at 3 × 1 m with Arabic notes. RollCue scales it and checks the effective resolution.

samples.title: poster-for-jars.pdf
samples.story: The filename says poster; the size, quantity, stock and notes say labels. RollCue weighs the whole job, not the name.

samples.title: Cut path with the wrong name
samples.story: The die line is named "Cut Contour" with a space. The cutter would ignore it, so RollCue returns it rather than guess.
